findings.evidence: Basic.lean:103-105 `congr_arg Cardinal.toNat (Submodule.IsLattice.rank' ℚ L.carrier)` and Dual.lean:190-192 `congr_arg Cardinal.toNat (Submodule.IsLattice.rank' ℚ L.dualCarrier)` are the only two hits of `IsLattice.rank'` in TauCeti; Mathlib has no finrank form (`Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Lattice.lean` only has `finrank_of_pi`).

summary: The main construction is new (Mathlib's DualLattice.lean:67 still lists perfectness as a TODO), but the file re-derives a located Mathlib symmetry lemma, duplicates the dual-basis pairing computation in two proofs, clones an existing finrank one-liner, and adds a consumer-less parallel double-duality lemma.
